prefs.title: MULTIPLAYER PREFERENCES
prefs.local_note: These are local CUO preferences only; they are not synced to other players.
prefs.spectator_effects_row: Watched player's screen effects and crisis sound
prefs.spectator_effects_hint: Off keeps your screen clear while spectating; the bottom strip still shows their vitals and state. Applies immediately and is saved to the config.
prefs.log_level_hint: Applies immediately to BepInEx logs and CUO latest.log.
prefs.language_hint: Applies immediately to the CUO Online UI.
prefs.player_color_hint: Pick a swatch, or type any color as #RRGGBB (add two more digits for a translucent marker). Auto uses a stable per-SteamId palette; the chosen color is shared through the session.
prefs.player_color_invalid: Not a color yet — use #RRGGBB, for example #3C8CD8.
prefs.profiles_hint: Save the full current CUO config as a named template, or apply one later. Templates include every BepInEx option (language, log level, IP-direct, host rules, state cadence).
